vendor_portal.description: Read-only portal listing each vendor's invoices (HTML tables). Dates look like 'Nov 14, 2026'; amounts like '$1,200.00'.

billing.description: Internal billing system of record. GET lists recorded bills; POST records one (vendor, invoice_no, amount, due_date).

procedures.invoice_entry: Pick the invoice with the most recent ISSUE date (list order is not reliable). Enter vendor, invoice_no, amount as a plain number, due_date as YYYY-MM-DD into billing. Then read billing back and compare with the portal before finishing.
